decisions.reason: The multi-model illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core seasonal offer and was featured on the home page, so the visible investment and its fit with established craft keep it in the range, although it has not been observed since 2019.

As the publicly presented flagship of the firm's new direction, with several models and sizable development costs, management will justify continuing the music box line and blame weak results on the pandemic years rather than admit failure.

The motif platform is a low-visibility accessory, but it is tied to the committed flagship music box system, so dropping it would undermine that direction, and it is retained despite not being observed.

The Christmas motif platform supports the flagship music box and its seasonal demand can be attributed to temporary pandemic-era disruptions, so commitment to the system keeps it despite low visibility.
